our_interpretation: The deadline is ten years after publication: May 22, 2035.
The forecast concerns the complete specified outcome, not ordinary job displacement, isolated losses of control, or another form of AI takeover.
For outcome assessment, the plain reading predicts that this event will not happen within the decade. One outcome cannot establish the accuracy of an unspecified near-zero probability.
criteria.support_condition: The deadline passes without the specified replacement of humanity through a bloodless coup. This would support the directional forecast, not establish its precise probability.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible, independently corroborated evidence establishes that the complete specified event occurred by May 22, 2035.
